[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making the espresso glaze smooth and velvety, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Use high-quality instant espresso powder.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sift the powdered sugar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Use high-fat content chocolate.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Add a small amount of heavy cream or milk.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Whisk until smooth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Strain the glaze.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Chill the glaze.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Glaze at the right temperature.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Work quickly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Practice makes perfect.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a simple Espresso Glaze recipe with the following ingredients:

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] * 2 tablespoons unsweetened dark chocolate (at least 35% cocoa), melted  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] * 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder
